scope: Independent AI-assisted source-versus-render visual review of coarse exterior identity/topology only, not measured fidelity or print certification
source_images_personally_viewed: Official NCKU museum PDF53 embedded museum53-000.jpg (oblique), museum53-001.jpg (road front), museum53-002.jpg (campus rear)
Photographer article https://oitaiwan.jp/post-4663/ IMG_6404, IMG_6409, IMG_6406, IMG_6414; full1920x1280 in source research

checks.front.png: Road-facing one central door and two narrow windows, forecourt parapet, through-arch and annex end lattice preserved. Main roof hip-and-gable hierarchy recognizable.
checks.rear.png: Campus-facing upper wall blank rather than mirrored front openings. Lower annex shelves and hip/gable silhouette retained.
checks.elevation.png: Compact arched gatehouse with wider lower base, central taller chamber and flanking descending shed roofs; no major count or identity conflict observed.
checks.top.png: Rearward upper mass and front terrace retained. Plan depth and terrace proportions are inferred, not verified by a surveyed overhead source.
checks.left_oblique.png: Opposite annex and front terrace continuity visible; simplified lattice recess and pale shelf extend slightly beyond base, consistent with photo silhouette.

limitations: Unmeasured overall depth, terrace depth, wall batter/taper and chamber proportions are approximate; no current2026 condition survey.
Smooth faces omit brick courses and individual roof tiles, roof-end bead profile and carved inscriptions; appearance is deliberately coarse rather than a faithful masonry restoration.
Ridge upturn, gable/roof curvature, small swallowtail branches and end ornaments are reduced/omitted; roof slopes are simplified planar patches.
Exact lattice arrangement, door/window frames, corbel and bracket shapes are simplified; no claim of opening-count or fine-decoration metrology.
No aerial/survey plan proves hidden terrace geometry. Top view is a modeled interpretation, not direct observational confirmation.
Adjacent historic city walls, terrain stairs, artillery, vegetation and modern fixtures excluded.
Source-view foreshortening prevents precise roof-height ratio verification. This review approves coherent coarse exterior topology, not percentage fidelity.
Rendering review does not certify mesh, SDK, rebuild, slice or physical printing tests; those require separate QA.
hash_binding_rule: Any change to the three artifacts or five preview files invalidates this review binding; re-review required.
